item.tib: gsang sngags kyi rgyud rgya che rol pa las bstan srung dge bsnyen mchod pa ra sa ya na'i sman sdong
item.coloph: gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud las/ mtha' yi gnas bstan bstan srung dge bsnyen gyi mchod pa la/ ra sa ya na'i sman sdong zhes bya ba phyi rabs kyi 'gal rkyen bsal zhing mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i phyir/ gsang sngags gling pas sbyar ba'o//
